description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the NationalityDao component in the OrangeHRM project. It tests CRUD operations and lookup methods for the Nationality entity, ensuring the data access layer functions correctly within the HRM system.

classes.name: NationalityDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the NationalityDao CRUD operations and lookup methods within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by initializing the NationalityDao instance and populating the test database with predefined data.

methods.name: testAddNationality
methods.description: Tests adding a new Nationality entity and verifies it was persisted correctly.

methods.name: testEditNationality
methods.description: Tests editing an existing Nationality entity and verifies the update.

methods.name: testGetNationalityList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of Nationality entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetNationalityById
methods.description: Tests fetching a Nationality by its ID and verifying its properties.

methods.name: testGetNationalityByName
methods.description: Tests fetching a Nationality by name, including case-insensitivity and trimming, ensuring correct retrieval or null if not found.

methods.name: testDeleteNationalities
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple Nationalities by their IDs and verifies the number of deletions.

methods.name: testIsExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks whether a given nationality name exists, including case and whitespace variations.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests deletion with IDs that do not exist in the database and verifies that zero deletions occur.
